admissions.q: What are the eligibility criteria for each program?
admissions.a: For undergraduate programs (BBA, BCA), you need a 10+2 qualification with at least 50% marks from a recognized board. For postgraduate programs (MBA, MCA, PGDM), we require a bachelor's degree with a minimum of 50% (45% for SC/ST candidates), along with a valid score in CMAT, CAT, XAT, MAT, NMAT, or our own DIMTECH Aptitude Test (DMAT).

The process is simple: apply online, upload your required documents, and appear for a personal interview or the DMAT entrance test. Once selected, you can secure your seat by paying the first fee installment.

admissions.q: Which documents are needed for the application?
admissions.a: Please keep the following ready: your 10th and 12th marksheets, graduation degree (if applying for PG), a valid government ID, 8 passport-size photographs, and your entrance exam scorecard (if applicable).

admissions.q: When is the last date for admissions?
admissions.a: Admissions typically remain open until August of each academic year. However, seats fill up quickly, so we highly recommend applying early.
Absolutely. Foreign and NRI students are welcome and can apply directly through our international admissions cell, subject to standard passport and visa verification.

admissions.q: How can I check my application status?
admissions.a: You can track your status anytime by logging into the admissions portal. Alternatively, feel free to contact our admissions office at +91 9289400945 or email info@dimtech.org.

admissions.q: Can I change my course after admission?
admissions.a: Yes, course changes (e.g., from BBA to BCA) are permitted within the first semester. This is subject to seat availability and final approval from the academic department.

courses.q: Is the PGDM course AICTE-approved and industry-relevant?
courses.a: Yes, our PGDM program is fully AICTE-approved. We actively collaborate with industry leaders to design a curriculum that meets current market demands.

courses.q: Are dual specializations available in PGDM or MBA?
courses.a: Yes, we offer dual specializations to give you a competitive edge. Popular combinations include Marketing & Finance, and HR & Business Analytics.

courses.q: How often is the PGDM curriculum updated?
courses.a: We review and update the curriculum annually to ensure it reflects the latest trends in business and technology.

courses.q: Are soft-skill sessions part of the program?
courses.a: Absolutely. We host regular sessions focused on communication, public speaking, and overall personality development to make you corporate-ready.
Yes, students have access to over 30 value-added certification programs, including Digital Marketing, Python, and Data Analytics.

fees.q: What is the total fee for each program?
fees.a: Our complete, updated fee structure is published annually. Please refer to the official fee page on our website for a detailed breakdown.
Yes, we offer scholarships of up to 50% to support our students. These are awarded based on academic merit, exceptional sports achievements, or financial need.
DIMTECH maintains a strict non-refundable policy once your admission is confirmed and fees are paid.

fees.q: How are examination or academic changes communicated?
fees.a: All important updates, including exam fee schedules and academic calendar changes, are posted well in advance on the student portal and campus notice boards.

placements.a: All our major programs, including PGDM, MBA, BBA, and BCA, come with 100% placement assistance and comprehensive job-readiness training.

placements.q: Who is eligible for placement assistance?
placements.a: Students who maintain a minimum of 75% attendance, clear all their academic papers, and complete their required internships on time are fully eligible for placement support.

placements.q: How will the college help me get a placement?
placements.a: Our dedicated placement cell proactively prepares you through mock interviews, aptitude training, and company-specific workshops before the final recruitment drives begin.

placements.q: What salary packages can I expect?
placements.a: Our graduates typically secure average packages ranging between ₹6 LPA and ₹10 LPA, depending on the specific course, chosen specialization, and recruiting company.
While it varies by role and location, our students generally secure paid internships offering between ₹10,000 and ₹25,000 per month.
Internship placements typically kick off during the second semester for postgraduate programs, and the fifth semester for undergraduate programs.
Yes, our campus recruiters include top-tier global companies like Deloitte, Infosys, IBM, HDFC, and many others.

hostel.a: No, hostel facilities are provided at an additional cost, with annual packages starting from ₹90,000.

hostel.q: How will the college help me find an affordable hostel?
hostel.a: If our on-campus housing is full or beyond your budget, our hostel office will happily assist you in finding safe, budget-friendly options near the campus through our approved housing partners.
DIMTECH offers a vibrant campus experience featuring full Wi-Fi coverage, modern smart classrooms, a well-stocked library, a lively cafeteria, and diverse cultural and technical clubs.

facilities.q: What facilities are available for students?
facilities.a: Our campus is fully equipped with smart classrooms, advanced computer labs, a comprehensive library, a cafeteria, a dedicated medical room, transport services, and excellent sports facilities.

facilities.q: Does the college support students after course completion?
facilities.a: Yes, your relationship with DIMTECH continues after graduation. We provide ongoing alumni support, including exclusive job updates and networking events.

facilities.q: How can students resolve queries quickly?
facilities.a: We have multiple support channels. You can visit the student helpdesk, speak directly with your academic coordinator, or raise a ticket on our 24/7 online grievance portal.

examinations.q: What is the minimum attendance required?
examinations.a: We require students to maintain a minimum of 75% attendance in every subject to be eligible for final examinations.

examinations.q: What if a student does not meet the minimum attendance?
examinations.a: Students falling below the 75% threshold may be barred from taking exams or required to repeat the semester, in line with university regulations.

examinations.q: What is the minimum passing percentage?
examinations.a: To pass, you must secure a minimum of 40% in each individual subject and maintain an overall aggregate of 50%.

examinations.q: What if a student fails in any course?
examinations.a: Don't worry—students have the opportunity to clear their backlogs by reappearing in supplementary exams, which are held shortly after the main semester exams.

international.q: Can international students apply for DIMTECH courses?
international.a: Yes, DIMTECH proudly accepts international applications through our dedicated global admissions desk.

international.q: What additional documents are required for NRI students?
international.a: In addition to standard academic records, NRI and foreign students must provide a valid passport, a student visa, an equivalence certificate, and verifiable proof of financial support.

alumni.q: What is career guidance and how does it help?
alumni.a: Our career guidance program helps you identify your professional goals, prepares you thoroughly for interviews, and maps out the best possible career trajectory for your skills.

alumni.q: Does the college have mentorship programs?
alumni.a: Absolutely. Every student is personally paired with a mentor—drawn from our faculty or our extensive alumni network—to provide continuous guidance and support.

alumni.q: What kind of alumni network does the college have?
alumni.a: DIMTECH boasts a highly active and influential alumni association, with graduates working across top multinational companies and innovative startups both in India and globally.

general.a: Our campus is situated at Plot No. 30/5 & 30/6, Knowledge Park III, Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh (201310). We are conveniently located near the metro station and major commercial hubs.
You can reach us via email at info@dimtech.org, call us on +91 9289400945, or use our toll-free landline: 1800 270 7021.

general.q: What accreditation does the college have?
general.a: DIMTECH is fully AICTE-approved and proudly affiliated with a recognized state university, ensuring your degree holds immense value.

general.q: Does the college have multiple branches?
general.a: No, to maintain our high standards of quality and focus, DIMTECH operates from a single, state-of-the-art campus in Greater Noida.
